teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: apple, banana, orange, potato, tomato, meat, chicken, fish, milk, cheese, butter, egg

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
apple, banana, orange, potato, tomato, meat, chicken, fish, milk, cheese, butter, egg
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What do you like to eat? (asking food preferences)
• I like fresh fruit and vegetables (stating likes)
• We need some milk and cheese (expressing shopping needs)
• Is there any bread? (asking existence of food)
Pronunciation Focus:
Vowel sounds in 'apple' /ˈæp.əl/ and 'cheese' /tʃiːz/.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Countable & Uncountable Nouns + Quantifiers ('some apple', 'some milk', 'a banana')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Countable & Uncountable Nouns + Quantifiers ('some apple', 'some milk', 'a banana')
Controlled Practice:
Yellow long fruit that monkeys like. What is it called?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: What do we have in the fridge?
B: We have some apples, tomatoes, and chicken.
A: Do we have any milk?
B: No, we need to buy some milk and butter.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to a person checking their kitchen food inventory and tick the items they have.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60m Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Grammar Practice; 40-55m Speaking Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.
• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
